about_the_game:
The castle

You and your group of friends decided to explore an isolated medieval castle for Halloween. At night, of course! But some places were never meant to be found and this castle is one of them.
You all get separated and things start to take a dark turn.

You are trapped. And you are not alone.

The castle is populated with dangerous Creatures which perform horrifying experiments on living humans. You are also constantly being watched...

You now need to search for your friends, uncover the truth behind this cursed place, and escape... before it's too late.

Gameplay

All you have with you is a malfunctioning torchlight.

As you progress through the castle, you will need to interact with your environment to solve unique puzzles, explore bizarre rooms, find hidden secrets and avoid deadly traps, all while staying out of sight of the Creatures.

You will also have to stay quiet to survive! All your movements create echoes. A visible sound gauge will react in real time to your actions: too much noise will alert the Guard who will come investigate the source: if he finds you, it's over.
If the gauge fills up completely, you will not have time to hide...

And remember: stay away from the Creatures...

Chose your path

You will face difficult choices throughout the game. Will you risk saving all of your friends or focus on your own survival?

Your decisions will lead to very different outcomes so chose wisely.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains intense violence, gore and general mature content, and may not be appropriate for all ages.

short_description: You were exploring a supernatural old castle with your friends… when things took a dark turn and you suddenly got separated! In this horror game, you will have to search for your friends, unravel the dark history of the place, and try to quietly escape… before it's too late.
